entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Colonel Muharrem Köse is an officer in the Turkish Armed Forces. He was claimed by unnamed sources in the Turkish security forces to have been a leader of the 2016 Turkish coup attempt on 15 July 2016. Köse had reportedly been expelled from the military some months earlier.

entities.name: Muharrem Köse
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Colonel Muharrem Köse is an officer in the Turkish Armed Forces. He was claimed by unnamed sources in the Turkish security forces to have been a leader of the 2016 Turkish coup attempt on 15 July 2016. Köse had reportedly been expelled from the military some months earlier.
